description:
The workspace's Toolbox: code and animations saved by earlier builds, for reuse.
- BEFORE writing a helper (chart layout, counters, text effects, easing, a data transform) or a scene the team has made before: toolbox({action: "find", query: "<what you are building>"}), then get the best match and use it.
- Using an item: JS helper -> require("toolbox/<name>") in run_script; Python helper -> a first line "# use: <name>" in run_code; page JS/CSS -> get returns its API, and get with include_code: true returns the code to copy into the site as is (don't retype it); an animation -> animation.place({animation, project_id, clip_index}).
- AFTER writing something another video could use: toolbox({action: "save", name, code | animation, summary, tags, usage}). The language is detected. Saving a name again adds a version; old versions stay, so nothing built on them changes. A save that reads like existing items lists them (similar): use or improve one of those instead of keeping a near-copy.
- Saving, removing and protecting need an editor or admin; a protected item changes only for its owners or an admin.

action.description: find: search the workspace's saved code and animations. get: one item's code. save: add an item (or a new version of a name). remove: take a name out. protect: only its owners or a workspace admin may change it from then on (protected: false lifts it).

animation.description: save: an animation of the project to keep (a COPY goes to the workspace library).

code.description: save: the helper's source. JS for run_script is a CommonJS module (module.exports = {...}).

dry_run.description: save: say what would happen, change nothing.

element_id.description: save: the animation element to keep instead.

entry.description: save: the page of a multi-page animation.

include_code.description: get: also return a page item's code (left out by default: copy it into the site with it, don't read it).

kind.description: find: only code or only animations.

language.description: find: only this language. save: only to correct the detected one (js = run_script, python = run_code, page = JS/CSS a page copies).

name.description: get/save/remove: the item's name, lowercase-with-dashes ('bar-layout'). get takes 'name@3' for a version.

owners.description: protect: the user ids who may change it (default: you).

project_id.description: save of an animation: its project.

protected.description: protect: true (default) to protect, false to lift it.

query.description: find: what you are about to build, in words ('bar chart race', 'logo intro').

rev.description: get: a version other than the latest.

summary.description: save: what it does and when to reach for it (find searches this). Required.

usage.description: save: how to call it -- its functions and arguments, an example.

name: toolbox
title: Toolbox: the workspace's saved code
